headline: ChipNexus adds checked CDL-to-schematic import to its analog design agent
fact: ChipNexus announced NEX v5.85 with CDL netlist import into Virtuoso schematics through batch Spice In. The release describes re-exporting the schematics and comparing pins, device counts, connectivity, dimensions and multiplicities against the original netlist, with mismatches reported. This extends the analog mode introduced in October rather than establishing customer adoption or independently verified circuit performance. The official guide limits simulation results to pre-layout; parasitic extraction and post-layout performance are outside the toolset.

sources.title: NEX v5.85 is out now: Build Your Own Agent.
sources.summary: Company release notes dated November 3, 2026 describe CDL-to-Virtuoso schematic import, round-trip checks and device-parameter validation. This is a vendor feature announcement, not a customer result.

sources.title: Virtuoso Sub-Agent
sources.summary: Official guide describes schematic import/export and round-trip differences, required licensed EDA tools and explicit pre-layout-only simulation scope. The guide is supporting current documentation, not the source of the release date.
